findings.reason: Real UI water/light/temperature/baseline selectors now change the selected fixed synthetic model. Two independent virtual dishes per seed treatment and three independent virtual O2 setups per light treatment are explicit. Controls lock during runs, raw initial/end values are recorded, and actual manual digital protocol entry works. Independent 19-run checks match all supplied rates/deltas. This offers executable model investigation and a clearly separated physical investigation plan; it does not certify real biological experiment execution.

A new actual own-organ-preparation demand uses a teacher-approved safe flower and blunt forceps. Stamen is correctly distinguished as a flower organ, with anther/filament, gentle release at the base, actual observation/labels, damage handling and own protocol/cleanup. Four model cards prepare actions but do not prove physical handling. Existing ready-slide and field tasks remain. The original partial NI relation and mammalian structure/function partner bdbb1a13-f448-5536-86ab-894805e2f6be remain unchanged and unclosed.

The actual official NI page76 says präparieren ein Organ. The six literal source-row fields now match it. No dissection obligation is fabricated. Original source bytes/parent passage and original 1:n partial mapping decision/partner roles remain. BB/BE broad original sourceRef2.1 routing context is retained; inquiry/protocol actual sections2.2.2/2.3.2 are recorded as context, not silently rewritten.
